ShabuBox 2.6.2

A small update that makes scanning more dependable on printers that also scan, especially ones that have both a document feeder and a glass flatbed.

Scanning

  • Scans finish when the pages are in — some scanners never tell the Mac that a scan has finished, so ShabuBox kept waiting for up to three minutes. ShabuBox now finishes as soon as your pages have arrived and the feeder is empty, and keeps any pages the scanner saved without reporting them.
  • The glass works when the feeder is empty — on a scanner with both a feeder and a flatbed, starting a scan with a page on the glass and nothing in the feeder used to end with "no pages". ShabuBox now scans the glass instead.
  • Unplugging ends the scan right away — if the scanner is switched off or disconnected mid-scan, ShabuBox stops waiting immediately and keeps any pages that already arrived.

Notes

  • No re-read, no library changes and nothing to do — this update installs and opens like any other.
